name: FutureOrBuilder
description: Renders a value that may already be available or may still be loading through one builder.
notes: No <name>_style.dart / <name>_theme.dart: the component paints nothing, so there is no token-derived property to theme.
The old `FutureOrWidgetBuilder<T>` typedef was dropped; Flutter's `AsyncWidgetBuilder<T>` is the same signature and is re-exported by widgets.dart.
